2. **mail_shim.rs (c3b.3)**: uncommitted since_ts/urgent filter work — compile state was transiently broken (E0425 parse_since_ts_us) while moving those fns; looks structurally fine now.

Land a compiling checkpoint when your chunks are stable — my gate runs the moment it compiles. No rush, just a green checkpoint.
